step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an automated big data processing workflow managed by a custom Resource Manager. 1) Data lands in an input S3 bucket, triggering notifications to high and low priority SQS queues. 2) Worker EC2 instances poll these queues for tasks. 3) Before submitting tasks, workers query the Resource Manager (running on EC2 backed by RDS and monitored by CloudWatch) to obtain available EMR cluster endpoints. 4) Workers submit data processing jobs to dynamic EMR clusters (using Spot instances via Instance Fleets). 5) Processed output data is stored in the output S3 bucket (EMRFS).
